component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.task = createObject("roSGNode", "WorkerTask") m.task.observeField("ready", "onReady") m.task.observeField("report", "onReport") m.task.control = "run" end sub
sub onReady() for i = 1 to 100 m.task.request = i end for print "SCENE SENT: 100 writes (1..100)" end sub
sub onReport(event as object) print "TASK SAW: "; event.getData() m.top.done = true end sub
